Subject: Detention fees on your lanes

Hi Sarah,

I read your post about detention fees eating into Q2 margins.

Lanewise tracks how long carriers sit at each facility, so you can see which ones turn around quickly before you book them. One of our customers, a building-supplies distributor, cut detention charges by 30% in their first quarter using that data.

Would a 15-minute call be useful? If you send me your busiest lanes ahead of time, I can bring the dwell numbers for the carriers you already use.
